seo.title: Bromo Ijen Tour from Surabaya — 12 Private Packages | JVTO
seo.description: Private 2D–6D Bromo, Ijen & Tumpak Sewu tours from Surabaya. Tourist Police-led, all-inclusive. 4.8★ Trustpilot. From IDR 1.55M/pax.

lede: Private 2D–6D Bromo, Ijen & Tumpak Sewu tours from Surabaya. Tourist Police-led, all-inclusive.

inclusions.label: Private transport
inclusions.detail: AC MPV (1–3 guests) or Toyota Hiace (4–9 guests). Fuel, tolls, and parking included.

inclusions.label: Dedicated crew
inclusions.detail: English-speaking driver-guide (1–3 guests), or professional driver + escort guide (4+ guests).

inclusions.label: Entrance fees & permits
inclusions.detail: All attractions on the itinerary — no surprise gate payments.

inclusions.label: Private 4WD Jeep
inclusions.detail: Bromo crater area. One jeep per ≤4 guests; additional jeeps for larger groups.

inclusions.label: Health-certificate coordination
inclusions.detail: For Ijen routes when current access rules require it.

inclusions.label: Pick-up to drop-off
inclusions.detail: Full assistance from your Surabaya hotel or address.

whyItems.title: Police-Led Operations
whyItems.body: Mr. Sam holds the rank of Bripka — active officer of Tourist Police (POLPAR) Bondowoso, East Java. Confirmed by Detik.com, 2021. No other East Java operator is led by a serving Tourist Police officer.

whyItems.title: 100% Private — No Shared Groups
whyItems.body: Your booking receives a dedicated vehicle and crew. No join-in option exists. Group size determines vehicle type; timing and route decisions apply to your group only.

whyItems.title: All-Inclusive — Written Before You Book
whyItems.body: Inclusions and exclusions are published on every package page and confirmed in your voucher. Mid-trip negotiations over costs do not occur on JVTO routes.

whyItems.title: Verifiable Credentials
whyItems.body: NIB 1102230032918 verifiable via OSS. HPWKI AHU-0001072.AH.01.07.TAHUN 2024. BBKSDA clearance and POLPAR authorisation on file. All guides hold KTA 2024.

bookingSteps.text: WhatsApp +62 822 4478 8833 with your dates, group size, and preferred package.
Receive a price confirmation per the pricing table for your group size.
Pay 20% deposit via secure JVTO checkout to confirm the booking.
Receive your e-voucher with full trip details and a pre-trip guide.
